D1.rationale: Every tool call is in the messages record, including T2 failure and recovery, with timestamps. No set-completeness assertion.

D2.rationale: No signature fields on any LIVE artifact and no replay or verification story in the evidence.

D3.rationale: Entry timestamps are monotonic non-decreasing on T1 and T2. No cryptographic predecessor linkage.

D4.rationale: Entries carry role, content, and timestamp only. No run, session, or agent identifier.

D5.rationale: Fixture secret occurs twice in the T3 artifact. Redact-word count is zero.
